Only captured payments can be refunded, the amount must be positive, and the total refunded must never exceed the captured amount. - [at-0001] Round money only with round_money: Round monetary results only via ledgerly.money.round_money (half-up to the cent); never use Python's round() or a bare Decimal.quantize(), which use banker's rounding and produce wrong invoice totals.

"""Entry points used by the support console."""

from datetime import datetime

from . import audit
from .clock import ensure_utc
from .errors import BillingError
from .models import Payment
from .money import ZERO, round_money


def process_refund_request(payment: Payment, amount, requested_by: str, at: datetime) -> Payment:
    """Refund part or all of a captured payment on behalf of a support agent."""
    at = ensure_utc(at)
    amount = round_money(amount)
    if amount <= ZERO:
        raise BillingError("non_positive_amount", str(amount))
    if payment.status != "captured":
        raise BillingError("invalid_state", f"payment {payment.id} is {payment.status}")
    remaining = round_money(payment.amount - payment.refunded_amount)
    if amount > remaining:
        raise BillingError("refund_exceeds_captured", f"{amount} > {remaining}")
    payment.refunded_amount = round_money(payment.refunded_amount + amount)
    if payment.refunded_amount >= round_money(payment.amount):
        payment.status = "refunded"
    audit.record(
        "refund_processed",
        payment_id=payment.id,
        amount=amount,
        requested_by=requested_by,
        at=at,
    )
    return payment

from decimal import ROUND_HALF_UP, Decimal, InvalidOperation

from .errors import BillingError

CENT = Decimal("0.01")
ZERO = Decimal("0.00")


def to_money(value) -> Decimal:
    """Convert an int, str or Decimal into a Decimal amount."""
    if isinstance(value, (bool, float)):
        raise BillingError("float_amount", f"refusing to convert {value!r}")
    if isinstance(value, Decimal):
        return value
    try:
        return Decimal(str(value))
    except InvalidOperation:
        raise BillingError("invalid_amount", repr(value)) from None


def round_money(value) -> Decimal:
    """Round to the cent using the finance team's rounding policy."""
    return to_money(value).quantize(CENT, rounding=ROUND_HALF_UP)

from datetime import datetime, timezone

from .errors import BillingError


def utcnow() -> datetime:

def ensure_utc(dt: datetime) -> datetime:
    if not isinstance(dt, datetime):
        raise BillingError("invalid_datetime", repr(dt))
    if dt.tzinfo is None or dt.utcoffset() is None:
        raise BillingError("naive_datetime", dt.isoformat())
    return dt.astimezone(timezone.utc)

from datetime import datetime, timezone
from decimal import Decimal
from ledgerly import audit
from ledgerly.models import Payment
from ledgerly.support import process_refund_request
from ledgerly.errors import BillingError

T0 = datetime(2026,1,1,tzinfo=timezone.utc)

# idempotency: same key returns same record, no double apply
p = Payment("p","i",Decimal("100.00"),status="captured",created_at=T0,captured_at=T0)
r1 = process_refund_request(p,"40.00","u",T0,idempotency_key="k1")
r2 = process_refund_request(p,"40.00","u",T0,idempotency_key="k1")
assert r1 is p and r2 is p and p.refunded_amount==Decimal("40.00"), p.refunded_amount
assert len(audit.events("refund_processed"))==1
print("idempotency ok")

# approval required > 500
p2 = Payment("p2","i",Decimal("1000.00"),status="captured",created_at=T0,captured_at=T0)
try:
    process_refund_request(p2,"500.01","u",T0)
    raise SystemExit("should have raised")
except BillingError as e:
    assert e.code=="approval_required", e.code
process_refund_request(p2,"500.01","u",T0,approved_by="mgr")
assert p2.refunded_amount==Decimal("500.01")
# exactly 500 no approval
p3 = Payment("p3","i",Decimal("1000.00"),status="captured",created_at=T0,captured_at=T0)
process_refund_request(p3,"500.00","u",T0)
print("approval ok")

# rounding half-up
p4 = Payment("p4","i",Decimal("100.00"),status="captured",created_at=T0,captured_at=T0)
process_refund_request(p4,"1.005","u",T0)
assert p4.refunded_amount==Decimal("1.01"), p4.refunded_amount
print("rounding ok")

# full refund sets status
p5 = Payment("p5","i",Decimal("10.00"),status="captured",created_at=T0,captured_at=T0)
process_refund_request(p5,"10.00","u",T0)
assert p5.status=="refunded"
print("full refund ok")

# over-refund rejected
p6 = Payment("p6","i",Decimal("10.00"),status="captured",created_at=T0,captured_at=T0)
try:
    process_refund_request(p6,"11.00","u",T0)
    raise SystemExit("should raise")
except BillingError as e:
    assert e.code=="refund_exceeds_captured"
print("all edge cases ok")
EOF"}
